result.title: One Phase Is Enough: Sim-to-Real Transfer with Direct Visual Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled impressive robotic behaviors, yet deploying policies directly from vision remains challenging. A common approach first trains a teacher policy with RL using privileged state observations, then distills its behavior into a vision-based student via imitation. However, the resulting student can substantially underperform its teacher. Directly training visual policies with RL offers a promising alternative, but learning task-relevant visual representations from scratch can be sample-inefficient, making one-phase visual RL intractable. We propose DRIFT, a simple recipe for efficient one-phase visual RL using image observations available at test time. Our key insight is to use frozen, pretrained foundation vision encoders, allowing RL to focus on learning control from existing visual representations. Freezing the encoder avoids costly backpropagation through the vision backbone, while its pretrained representations enable real-world transfer from fast, rasterized simulation rendering. Under matched architectures, observations, and compute budgets, DRIFT outperforms two-phase distillation and achieves a 58.8% relative improvement in average real-world success rate across three manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation evaluations demonstrate that DRIFT's relative advantage grows from roughly 9% in-distribution to over 61% under out-of-distribution shifts, suggesting that stronger generalization contributes to superior real-world transfer. Project website: https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DRIFT：单阶段直接视觉强化学习配方，冻结预训练基础视觉编码器，仅用 RL 训练控制策略，从而避免视觉骨干反传，并实现从快速光栅化仿真到真机的迁移；在三项操作任务上平均真实成功率相对两阶段蒸馏提升 58.8%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结视觉编码器＋轻量策略头」的视觉旁路式训练与 ID 到 OOD 增益放大的现象，可供核查 LVR 中视觉旁路是否保留任务必要视觉信息、以及冻结编码器对表示坍缩和分布偏移下 latent 内容稳定性的影响。
